integrity: The finite verification program tests examples and is not a substitute for the general field-theoretic proof. No independent scientific assessment has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers number fields, power maps and nonzero roots-of-unity targets only. A cyclotomic conductor gives a sufficient, not necessarily sharp, polynomial-onset bound. Standard Galois results and a 2026 root-order classification are required; historical priority cannot be guaranteed by searches.
title: Exact cyclotomic splitting and eventual polynomial factor counts for monomial preimages
